constants.DETAIL_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: quota exhausted — prepay the next batch

constants.REDIS_INCRBY_SCRIPT:
local v = redis.call('INCRBY', KEYS[1], ARGV[1])
if redis.call('PTTL', KEYS[1]) < 0 then
  redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[2])
end
return v
